items.t: Power module (TIPM) failure causes random electrical faults
items.job: Replace and program TIPM power module
items.note: Owners report total bills of about $700-$1,100. Remanufactured units cost less but quality varies.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace TIPM or fuel pump relay as needed
items.note: Low end is a relay; high end is a new TIPM.

items.t: Transmission shudder, slipping or hard shifts
items.job: Transmission software update, fluid service or torque converter replacement
items.note: A reflash and fluid service is the cheap end; a new torque converter means removing the transmission.

items.t: Automatic transmission whine or failure
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission

items.t: Rear differential seal leak and bearing failure
items.job: Replace pinion seal, or rebuild rear differential if bearings are worn
items.note: A seal alone is a few hundred dollars; a rebuild or new axle runs $1,100-$2,600 per owner reports.

items.t: Dropped valve seat and misfire on the 3.7L V6
items.job: Rebuild or replace cylinder head
items.note: If a piston is damaged, a used or rebuilt engine is often the better option.

items.t: Heat shield can rub through the driveshaft (recall)
items.job: Install heat shield support bracket
items.note: A driveshaft already damaged before the recall may cost extra.

items.t: Fuel spits back at the pump or tank cracks near the filler
items.job: Repair EVAP vent or replace fuel tank
items.note: Owners report about $450 for vent repairs and about $1,500 for a new tank.

items.t: Power window regulator breaks or window won't go up
items.job: Replace window regulator (and motor if needed)
items.note: Typical reported cost about $200; a master switch is cheaper.

items.t: Heater fan stops working or works only on high
items.job: Replace blower motor or blower resistor

items.t: A/C blows warm air
items.job: A/C leak test and recharge, or compressor replacement
items.note: A recharge with leak repair is the low end; a new compressor is the high end.

items.t: No start from anti-theft key system
items.job: Diagnose immobilizer and reprogram or replace key module

items.t: Power door locks stop working or cycle on their own
items.job: Replace door lock actuator

items.t: Rear brakes and rotors wear out early
items.job: Replace rear pads and rotors

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can come loose in an airbag deployment (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag cover

items.t: Front head restraint pops forward on its own
items.job: Inspect striker pin and replace active head restraint
items.note: Free if your truck is still inside the warranty extension; check with a dealer.

items.t: Active head restraints may not deploy in a crash (recall)
items.job: Active head restraint recall repair

items.t: Steering column rivet may be missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair steering column

items.t: ABS hydraulic unit can leak brake fluid (recall)
items.job: ABS hydraulic unit recall repair

items.t: Brake booster pushrod clip may come off (recall)
items.job: Inspect and install brake booster clip

items.t: Wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Add wiper relays and update TIPM software

items.t: ABS software can delay braking (recall)
items.job: Reprogram ABS module

items.t: Power module software can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Reprogram TIPM

items.t: Parking brake may not hold on manual-transmission models (recall)
items.job: Replace parking brake lever assembly
